biggest_catch: Election Day is a ~15.25-hour day (5:15am-8:30pm) for a flat $300; training is mandatory and training pay is not separately quantified.
catches: Must be 18+, registered to vote in Burlington County, able to read/write legibly, and available 5:15am-8:30pm on November 3, 2026.
Mandatory in-person training is required; training pay is offered only if the worker serves on Election Day, and its amount is not stated.
Training pay amount is not published; it is not included in the numeric figures.

eligibility: 18+, registered to vote in Burlington County, able to read and write legibly; available approx. 5:15am-8:30pm on November 3, 2026; complete mandatory in-person training.
notes: Official county release for the November 3, 2026 General Election. Training pay is promised but amount unstated, so the $300 Election Day figure is the concrete route; training pay noted in catches.
numeric_basis: payout from official terms ($300 flat Election Day); time: official ~5:15am-8:30pm = 915 min
payout_quote: Prospective poll workers must be 18 years or older, registered to vote in Burlington County, and able to read and write legibly. They should also be available to work from approximately 5:15 AM to 8:30 PM on Election Day, November 3, 2026. No experience is needed, but mandatory in-person training is required. Poll workers will be paid $300 for working Election Day. Poll workers will also receive pay for training, provided they work on Election Day.
payout_value_note: Flat $300 for working Election Day, November 3, 2026; separate training pay promised but amount not published.

s1.note: 18+, registered voter in county, literate; available Election Day.

s6.note: Steps concrete: apply online, complete mandatory training, serve Election Day.

steps: Be 18+, a registered Burlington County voter, able to read and write legibly.
Apply online at the county ElectionForce portal or contact the Board of Elections (609-265-5557).
Serve on Election Day, November 3, 2026, approximately 5:15 AM to 8:30 PM.
Receive $300 pay for Election Day (training pay separately, amount unstated).
timing: Election Day, November 3, 2026; training in advance.
